description: A drop-in clinic is performing a test either through the ear or blood. A blood test takes 30 minutes to perform while an ear test takes 5 minutes to perform. Since the blood test is more accurate, at least three times as many blood tests should be performed as ear tests. However, at least 12 ear tests must be administered. If the drop-in clinic operates for 7525 minutes, maximize the number of tests that can be performed.

TimePerBloodTest.definition: Time required to perform a blood test in minutes

TimePerEarTest.definition: Time required to perform an ear test in minutes

BloodToEarTestRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of blood tests to ear tests

MinEarTests.definition: Minimum number of ear tests to be administered

TotalOperatingTime.definition: Total operating time of the clinic in minutes

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of tests (blood tests and ear tests combined) that can be performed during the clinic's operating time."

constraints.description: 30 * (number of blood tests) + 5 * (number of ear tests) <= 7525
Number of blood tests >= 3 * (number of ear tests)
